title: Flows climbs to the top
description: one row per product, one cell per quarter · darker = higher rank · a bar race you can print

props.name: data
props.description: Product ranks indexed by period. Positive safe integers are available, and rows sort by the final declared period with missing final ranks last. Rank 1–5 tones stay absolute; lower ranks retain the palest tone.

props.name: periods
props.description: Ordered period labels. Repeated labels remain separate columns; extra ranks beyond this window are not displayed.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
